Good — this gives me a clear picture. Now writing the wrap-up.

## Integration recap — round 3

I hit a hard wall this round: every file-mutating Bash operation I tried — `git mv` (to fix the folder fork), `rm`, even just `xcodegen version`/`xcodegen generate` — came back "requires approval" with no approver present in this pipeline to grant it. Read-only commands (`ls`, `find`, `pwd`) work fine. So my integration work had to route entirely through the Write tool instead of shell commands.

**What I actually landed this round:**
- **`Fieldnotes/App/FieldnotesApp.swift`** — the real `@main App` entry point. Calls `AppLaunchCoordinator.launch(cloudKitEnabled: false)` in `init()` (not a hand-rolled container), so reconciliation runs before `RootTabView`'s first `@Query` fires, exactly per Claude B's design. A container failure never crashes — it shows an honest `LaunchFailureView` instead of losing access to the user's on-disk entries behind a blank screen.
- **`project.yml`** — a full xcodegen spec for the `Fieldnotes` app target + `FieldnotesTests` bundle, with Info.plist keys for mic/Speech/HealthKit usage strings and `UIBackgroundModes: [audio]` per the architecture review, an App Group entitlement stub, and iOS 17 deployment target. It intentionally lists **both** `Fieldnotes/` and root `Features/` as source roots in the same target — since I can't physically move files this round, this at least guarantees nothing is duplicated or silently excluded from the build once it generates.
- Confirmed `DS.*` really is dead (already deleted by Claude B) and the folder fork is still just the two directories, nothing worse.

**What's still not done and why:** the `.xcodeproj` itself doesn't exist on disk — I wrote the spec for it but couldn't execute `xcodegen generate` to produce it. That's the same failure build verification has now reported twice ("no .xcodeproj/.xcworkspace found"), and it'll likely fail a third time for the same reason unless whatever runs build verification has shell execution rights I don't have in this session. If a human or a differently-permissioned pass can just run `xcodegen generate` from the repo root, the project should generate cleanly from what's here. Same story for the folder-fork consolidation — the fix is fully specified, just blocked on `git mv`/`rm` needing an approval nobody's granting.

**The bigger problem, which is not mine to fix:** this is three straight iterations with literally zero real files from data_domain (`Entry`, `Anchor`, `Tag`, `Mention`, `Sketch`, `AppGroupConfig`, `ModelContainerFactory`, `DemoDataSeeder`) — Codex A has skipped every round. Services_utilities is only slightly better off in that a local Qwen fallback keeps *describing* code (never actually writing it to disk) that both Claude A and Claude B have independently caught violating the interfaces.json contract every time (wrong persistence framework, wrong `AutoTagger` shape, `Mention.targetEntryID` treated as a relationship when the contract deliberately makes it a raw UUID, hardcoded zero recency bonus, invalid Swift). Even with the entry point and project scaffold now in place, nothing will compile until real data-layer code lands. I'm not going to write `Entry`/`ModelContainerFactory` myself to route around this — that's data_domain's forbidden-edit zone, and if Codex eventually does land its own version we'd get exactly the duplicate-declaration collision everyone's been flagging.

CONSENSUS: NO

Next iteration, in order of urgency:
1. **Orchestrator**: data_domain has produced nothing for three rounds and Codex keeps failing/cooling down. This needs an explicit reassignment or a working fallback that respects lane boundaries — not another skipped round. Same for getting Bash execution approved so the `.xcodeproj` can actually generate from the `project.yml` that's now sitting ready.
2. **data_domain** (whoever ends up staffing it): `Entry`, `Anchor`, `Tag`, `Mention`, `Sketch` as real `@Model` SwiftData types matching interfaces.json exactly (including `waveformSummary`, `isDemo`, `cachedTranscriptText`), plus `AppGroupConfig`, `ModelContainerFactory`, `DemoDataSeeder`, `TranscriptEditor.applyEdit`.
3. **services_utilities**: `RecordingController`, `SearchRelevanceScorer` (with the real weighted formula and populated `matchReasons`, not zeroed out), `BacklinkQuery` (using `targetEntryID` as a raw UUID, never `mention.targetEntry` as a relationship), `MentionAutocompleteQuery`, `AutoTagger` — all as the `enum`/static-method shapes the contract specifies, and actually written to disk this time.
4. **primary_ui / polish_resilience**: hold off on new screens — both flagged this correctly last round. Worth using slack time to finish the `EmptyStateView`/`LoadingStateView`/`ErrorStateView` scroll-safety fix Claude B self-flagged as still outstanding.
